name: io.github.bsayres/heronhex-labor
title: Higher Ed: Labor Market
description: Align college programs with labor-market demand (CIP-SOC, BLS, O*NET, Scorecard). Read-only.

environmentVariables.name: COLLEGE_SCORECARD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free api.data.gov key (https://api.data.gov/signup). Optional: without it the shared DEMO_KEY is used, which allows only about 10 requests.

environmentVariables.name: HIGHERED_MCPS_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: Your email address, required by BLS in the User-Agent for its Employment Projections download. Sent only to www.bls.gov; never logged or returned.

environmentVariables.name: HIGHERED_MCPS_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the local cache of downloaded public data (default ~/.cache/highered-mcps).
